carousel-8.claim: 5 ancient lines for when life gets heavy.

carousel-9.quote: I judge you unfortunate because you have never been unfortunate. You have passed through life without an adversary; no one will know what you were capable of, not even you.
carousel-9.note: The easy life never finds out who you are.

carousel-10.quote: Nothing happens to anyone that he can’t endure.
carousel-10.note: Others have carried this exact weight. You can too.

carousel-11.quote: What would Hercules have been if there had been no lion, hydra, stag or boar?
carousel-11.note: No monsters, no hero. Your problems are the plot.

carousel-12.quote: What does not kill me makes me stronger.
carousel-12.note: Overused because it’s true. But only if you let it work on you.
carousel-12.cite: Nietzsche · Twilight of the Idols, Maxims 8

carousel-13.quote: He who suffers before it is necessary, suffers more than is necessary.
carousel-13.note: Most of the weight is tomorrow's. Put it down until tomorrow.

carousel-14.line: Which one do you need this week?
carousel-14.action: Save this. Send it to someone who’s going through it.

story-16-purpose-seneca.label: Identity
lines: “Philosophy moulds and constructs the soul; it orders our life, guides our conduct, shows us what we should do and what we should leave undone.”
quote
This isn’t a hobby. It’s a map. Read one page of Marcus or Epictetus before you open any app today.
body

story-17-beauty-marcus.label: Journal
lines: “Even the by-products of nature have a grace and charm of their own.”
quote
He meant bread cracking open in the oven, figs bursting, a lion’s heavy brow. Look at one ordinary thing tonight until it becomes beautiful.
body

story-18-suffering-frankl.label: Truths
lines: “When we are no longer able to change a situation, we are challenged to change ourselves.”
quote
Some things won’t move. The job, the diagnosis, the past. Then the work moves inside you. That’s not defeat. That’s the assignment.
body
story-18-suffering-frankl.cite: Viktor Frankl · Man’s Search for Meaning

story-19-virtue-epictetus.label: Discipline
lines: “Be silent for the most part, or speak only what is necessary.”
quote
Try it for one evening. Say less, listen more, and notice how much stronger you feel by the end.
body

story-20-amorfati-marcus.label: Truths
lines: “Whatever happens to you has been waiting to happen since the beginning of time.”
quote
Friday. Whatever today brings was always going to be yours. Meet it like you were expecting it.
body

story-21-beauty-nietzsche.label: Journal
lines: “Without music, life would be a mistake.”
quote
The man who wrote about suffering also wrote this. Put on the one song that makes you feel alive and play it loud tonight.
body
story-21-beauty-nietzsche.cite: Nietzsche · Twilight of the Idols · Maxims 33

story-22-virtue-marcus.label: Discipline
lines: “Injustice is often done by not doing.”
quote
Standing by is a choice. The friend who needs a call, the wrong you saw and ignored. Being a good man includes the things you didn’t do.
body

story-23-purpose-marcus.label: Identity
lines: “Concentrate every minute on doing what’s in front of you with precise and genuine seriousness.”
quote
Saturday night. Purpose isn’t one big thing you find. It’s the next thing in front of you, done properly.
body

story-24-amorfati-marcus.label: Truths
lines: “To love only what happens, what was destined. No greater harmony.”
quote
Sunday morning. Look back at the week and find one thing that went wrong that you can now be glad about.
body

story-25-beauty-epictetus.label: Journal
lines: “What else can I do, a lame old man, but sing hymns to God?”
quote
A former slave with a broken leg, teaching in exile, choosing gratitude. If he could sing, you can say thank you for one thing tonight.
body
